ios.desc:
Every morning at 6am ET, ten new trivia questions drop. Everyone on Earth
gets the same ten. You get ten seconds a question — and the faster you
answer, the more you score.

That's WHAMI. One game a day. No pausing, no takebacks, no googling
(you know who you are).

THE MEDIA ROUND
Questions 8, 9 and 10 are not like the others. Two song clips and a
photograph, every single day. Listen, name the artist before the timer
runs out, then see the album art you were hearing. If you miss the daily
song game you used to play, this is the part you came for.

HOW IT WORKS
• 10 questions daily, easy to brutal — the hard ones are worth the most
• 10 seconds each; speed multiplies your points
• Questions 8-10 are audio, photo, audio — the media round
• A perfect instant game scores 9,500 — nobody scores 9,500
• Share your spoiler-free result grid and dare your friends
• Build a daily streak and defend it
• Weekly leaderboard resets every Sunday — nobody stays buried

FRESH EVERY SINGLE DAY
Questions are written new each morning across sports, history, geography,
pop culture, science, famous people, and the occasional wild card. Same
questions for everyone, everywhere — puzzle #219 in Tokyo is puzzle #219
in Toledo.

NO ACCOUNT. NO PASSWORD. NO NONSENSE.
Pick a player name and play. That's the whole sign-up. No email, no
tracking, no ads.

Tomorrow's ten are already waiting. See you at 6am.

quotes.text:
For my Masters final project I had WHAMI built by offshore developers and it took 2 months.  I recently rebuilt it myself with Claude and I'd like you to give it a try.

10 Questions every day starting at 6am EST, but play anytime you'd like. 2 of the questions are music clips and one is a zoomed photo that slowly pulls back to show the entire image.

The faster you answer, the more points you get and the questions get progressively challenging.

iOS app available here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/whami-daily-trivia-quiz/id6799177635
